readings.Aries: The person who doubted you is still in your head. Evict them. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Taurus: You process change slowly and completely. The speed is not a flaw; the resistance is sometimes. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Gemini: You've been performing interest in something that no longer interests you. Stop. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Cancer: Someone needs your care. You need rest. Both things are true simultaneously. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Leo: The stage you've been avoiding is smaller than you imagine, and the audience is ready. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Virgo: There is order inside the disorder. You will find it. Give yourself the time. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Libra: The balance you're looking for is not a midpoint between two things — it's something new. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Scorpio: What looked like an ending was a shedding. The new layer is already forming. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Sagittarius: The thing you've been treating as small talk was actually a significant conversation. Revisit it. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Capricorn: Your work ethic is not in question. Your relationship to rest is the variable. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Aquarius: The community you're part of is drawing on your resources. Replenish. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Pisces: The dream you had — not the sleeping one — hasn't been attended to in some time. Return to it. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
